info.title: Payments
info.description: These APIs are specifically designed for payment use cases within the Walmart Marketplace.

servers.description: Refers to the URL used for accessing the production server.
Refers to the URL used for accessing the sandbox server.

get.description: The Entity Match API allows the Payout Service Providers (PSPs) to access entity profile data. The data includes seller's tax ID, legal business name, and the country of incorporation. PSPs can use this API to validate a seller's entity details during onboarding and payout processes.

parameters.name: WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN
parameters.description: Access token obtained from the Token API. This is required for authenticating requests to Walmart Marketplace APIs.

parameters.name: WM_CONSUMER.CHANNEL.TYPE
parameters.description: A unique ID to identify the consumer request by channel. Use the Consumer Channel Type received during onboarding.

parameters.name: WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID
parameters.description: A unique ID that identifies each API call and is used to track and debug issues. Use a randomly generated GUID for this ID

parameters.name: WM_SVC.NAME
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the Walmart service being called.

200.description: Request processed successfully. When status is OK, the response includes entity profile data in body.

schema.description: Response envelope for the entity match profile request.

body.description: Entity profile details returned for the seller.

businessRegistrationNumber.description: Seller business identifier used for entity matching. This could be the business registration number or tax identifier depending on country. Example: ABCD001122

name.description: Seller legal business name as registered with the issuing authority. Example: Business Name.

countryOfIncorporation.description: Country where the seller business is incorporated (typically an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code). Example: US

status.description: Overall outcome of the request. Example: OK

get.description: The Get Tax Forms API returns available tax forms for the authenticated seller, including form type and form ID. The response is a JSON object containing tax form metadata.

authorization.name: Authorization
authorization.description: Use a Basic Authorization header by Base64-encoding the Client ID and Client Secret obtained in step two of the integration process. Format the credentials as ClientID:ClientSecret before encoding.
